title: Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2609.08102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. We provide a mechanistic explanation and experimental evidence for why wavelet encodings are well matched to the dual spatial-spectral structure of the FNO, enabling deterministic mode selection on both continuous-valued and binary-valued geometries within a single model, and for why prediction accuracy varies with

translated_title: 基于小波编码傅里叶神经算子的超材料特征模态学习
translated_abstract: 基于神经算子的机器学习代理模型在求解偏微分方程（PDE）正问题方面展现出广泛的适用性。然而，特征值问题——需要同时求解一个特征参数和多个有效特征模态中的一个——仍然极具挑战性，因为标准的算子学习框架假设输入-输出映射是唯一的。这项工作表明，傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）与基于小波的PDE输入编码相结合，能够学习和预测弹性波方程的多个特征模态，这些模态对应于声波在任意超材料几何结构中传播时的变形模式。我们为小波编码为何与FNO的双重空间-频谱结构高度契合提供了机理解释和实验证据，这一契合使得单一模型能够在连续值和二值几何结构上实现确定性的模态选择，并解释了预测精度为何随……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出将小波编码与傅里叶神经算子相结合，突破了传统算子学习假设唯一输入-输出映射的限制，实现了在单一模型中学习并预测弹性波方程的多个特征模态，从而确定超材料中声波传播的变形模式。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators combined with wavelet-based PDE input encodings can learn and deterministically predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation within a single model, overcoming the unique input-output map limitation of standard operator learning for eigenvalue problems.
